what: SCOPE-0: what has been measured of two language models, site by site, copied from result files and never computed here

goldworm-v6.title: GoldWorm v6 (2.76 M parameters, byte level)
goldworm-v6.frame_reason: CAL-1: the writes sum to the final state (relative error 0.0) and rebuild the logits to 2.3e-5

gemma-4-e2b-q4.title: Gemma 4 E2B (4-bit file of the hand-over)
gemma-4-e2b-q4.frame_reason: the hand-over's attribution fails its additivity check (relative error 1.19); the file rescales the stream at each layer; a calibration (CAL-G) is frozen and not run

layers.title: Word identity
layers.kind: share of a write's variance explained by the word's form (eta squared), at a word's last byte
layers.null: the same with forms shuffled, 95th percentile
layers.question: Where is the word written?

layers.title: Part of speech, readable
layers.kind: accuracy of a linear probe for the part of speech (10 classes) on all test words
layers.null: the same probe on shuffled labels, 95th percentile (the same quantity)
layers.question: Where can a reader find the category?

layers.title: Readable beyond the surface bytes
layers.kind: probe accuracy on words not seen in fitting, minus the accuracy of a probe that sees only the word's bytes
layers.null: zero; the interval is beside each value
layers.question: Does the state hold the category, or only the spelling a reader could use?

layers.title: The category, written early
layers.kind: lift of adjectives over nouns when the layer is pushed along a direction that is neither the probe's nor a next-byte forecast, by the word's first letter, on unseen text
layers.null: zero; the interval is beside each value
layers.question: Is the category itself written, apart from what a reader finds and from the next byte?

layers.title: Reading against writing
layers.kind: angle between the direction a probe reads adjective-or-noun from and the direction the model writes it with
layers.null: two random directions in 192 dimensions: 81.9 to 98.1 degrees (95 %)
layers.question: Is what a reader finds what the model uses?

layers.title: Pushed along the writing direction
layers.kind: change in the log-probability of the adjective WORD after a determiner (summed over the word's bytes) when the layer's state is pushed along the WRITING direction at half the write's norm
layers.null: zero; the interval is beside each value
layers.question: Does pushing where the model writes move the behaviour?

layers.title: Pushed along the reading direction
layers.kind: the same push along the probe's READING direction at half the write's norm
layers.null: zero; the interval is beside each value
layers.question: Does pushing where a reader looks move the behaviour?

layers.title: Does direct attribution predict a knock-out?
layers.kind: correlation, over 2,000 positions, between a write's DIRECT attribution (final norm frozen, through the head) and the realised change in the true next byte's log-probability when that write is zeroed
layers.question: Can the effect of removing a block be read off without removing it?

layers.title: The kind, readable
layers.kind: accuracy of a linear probe for the twelve kinds on the layer's state, asked prompt, cross-validated
layers.null: chance is 1/12; no shuffled probe is stored in this file
layers.question: Where can a reader find the kind?

layers.title: The kind, said
layers.kind: accuracy of the model's OWN head applied to the layer's state (the twelve kind names)
layers.question: From where could the model itself say the kind?

layers.title: Is the kind view closed?
layers.kind: what the full state adds (R squared) to the kind view's prediction of its own next write, asked prompt
layers.null: the same for a view built from shuffled labels
layers.question: Does the kind predict its own next step, or does it need the rest?

layers.title: Removed, is it rebuilt?
layers.kind: final-layer probe accuracy after the kind subspace is removed at this layer, asked prompt
layers.null: the same after removing a variance-matched subspace disjoint from the kinds (control B)
layers.question: From which layer on is the kind carried and not rebuilt?

layers.title: Who pushes the answer (uncalibrated)
layers.kind: direct attribution of the answer margin to each block's write, items of kind Premises
layers.null: none; the frame does not close
layers.question: Which block pushes the answer toward or away from the right name?

fits.converged: the fit behind the value reached its stopping rule
fits.unconverged: the fit stopped at its iteration cap; the value is not a verdict
fits.n/a: no iterative fit, or the file does not say

standings.preregistered: measured under a preregistration, with an interval or a null beside it
standings.exploratory: formed by looking: descriptive or found while exploring; a lead, not a finding
standings.void: a number exists but its instrument does not hold here (the frame does not close, or the stake's plant failed); drawn as void, never as a value
